lines.text: Many learners say: The game was a big deception.
Better: The game was a big disappointment.
Disappointment! It was a big disappointment.

data.wrong: The game was a big deception.
data.right: The game was a big disappointment.

quiz.stem: My team lost. It was a big ___.

native.tip: “Deception” veut dire tromperie. Pour une déception, dis “disappointment”.
native.caption: Tu dis “The game was a big deception.” ? Faux ami ! Dis plutôt “The game was a big disappointment.”. Écoute Ama et répète avec elle ! Plus d'exercices dans l'appli Lexkite.

en.tip: “Deception” means a trick. For being let down, say “disappointment”.
en.caption: Do you say “The game was a big deception.”? False friend! Say “The game was a big disappointment.” instead. Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
